summary.issue_description: Caller's Central Bank of India account and phone number have been on hold for 8 months. This situation arose after 13000 rupees were accidentally transferred to his account, which he claims to have returned. He previously filed a complaint with the 1930 cyber helpline, but it remains unresolved.
dispatcher_actions: Asked for caller's bank details (bank name, account number)
Confirmed previous complaint was cyber-related and made to 1930
Took down the bank account number (3952541377)
Informed caller that information has been recorded and action will be taken
key_facts: Caller's Central Bank of India account (3952541377) is on hold.
Caller's phone number is also being held/blocked.
The issue originated from an accidental transfer of 13000 rupees into the caller's account, which he claims to have returned.
The account and phone number have been on hold for 8 months.
A previous complaint was filed with the 1930 cyber helpline but remains unresolved.
Caller is seeking resolution through 112 due to lack of resolution from previous complaint.
summary.final_summary: Aamanat Hussain from Bhopal reported an unresolved cybercrime issue. His Central Bank of India account (3952541377) and phone number have been on hold for 8 months. This situation arose after 13000 rupees were accidentally transferred to his account, which he states he returned. He had previously filed a complaint with the 1930 cyber helpline, but it remains unresolved. He is now seeking assistance from 112.
